fundamental.summary: NEE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 46 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (small purchases 88-109 days ago, one partial sale) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (290.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and imminent CPI event adds binary risk; utilities defensive but credit stress and equity volatility create hostile trading environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD bullish crossover and RSI rising across timeframes provides technical structure, while extreme fear (22/100) and inverted yield curve create contrarian utility sector opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch 88.45, StochRSI, Williams %R) combined with negative CMF, below-average volume, crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve recession signal, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create high pullback risk with unfavorable macro environment.
